verdict.line: You lose the poke war before level 6 when her Lunge (Q) can re-cast for free, but you win any fight where your E (Counter Strike) lands its stun while her Riposte (W) is down.

brief.thesis: Jax has no reliable poke at rank 1 — Q (Leap Strike) sits at 17s cooldown and E (Counter Strike) is only 300 range — so Fiora's Lunge (Q), which can be re-cast a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost, wins early pokes uncontested. Once Jax's E cooldown drops (18/16/14/12/10s by rank) and W (Empower) gets ranked up early per the standard skill order, the matchup flips into a duel where whoever lands their stun or parry first wins the fight — which is exactly why the measured win rate sits at a near-coinflip 48.4% over 221 games.

theirWindow.when: your E and Q are both down
theirWindow.what: She'll Lunge in freely since you have no dash or stun to punish the follow-up dash — hold position and let the wave push to you instead of extending.

yourWindow.when: your E is up, her W is down
yourWindow.what: Commit the all-in: E dodges her incoming autos for its duration then stuns and damages her, letting you chain empowered W autos and stack attack speed off R (Relentless Assault) while she can't parry back.

start.why: Measured 48.1% win rate over 81 games versus Doran's Blade's 45.6% — the sustain and poke reduction matter more here since Fiora's Lunge harasses you before your E cooldown comes down.

boots.why: Measured 48.1% win rate and the majority pick (72.8%) — Fiora's damage is entirely physical through her autos and Q, so flat armor from Steelcaps directly reduces every hit she lands.

core.why: Highest-sample core path (48.3% over 29 games) — the damage and tempo it adds to your empowered W autos is what turns level 9-12 fights in your favor.
Second item on the same 23%-pick path — its on-hit healing keeps you even in the extended auto-trades her Duelist passive is built to win.
Completes the top-sample build path — lets you survive her Blade Waltz (R) all-in once she hits level 6+ and reset the fight on your terms.

runes.keystoneWhy: This is the highest-sample rune page for the matchup (48.1% win rate, 28.6% pick) — the attack speed ramp stacks directly with R (Relentless Assault)'s own attack-speed gain, so your extended fights snowball faster than hers.

summoners.why: Best measured combo for this matchup (51.8% win rate, 72.8% pick) — Ignite denies the healing from her Duelist passive during your E-stun all-ins, which is when this lane is actually decided.

playing.title: Bait her Riposte before committing
playing.detail: Throw a single auto or a Q leap first to see if she parries. A landed Riposte gives her bonus AD and reflects magic damage back at you and costs you the tempo of that attack, so back off and reset for when it's down.

playing.title: All-in only when E is up and W is down
playing.detail: Your E (Counter Strike) dodges all her incoming basic attacks for its duration, then stuns and damages everyone around you — that window only exists when Riposte is on cooldown, so track it before you commit.

playing.title: Respect the second Lunge
playing.detail: Fiora can re-cast Q (Lunge) a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost, so don't treat her first dash as the end of the trade — a follow-up strike is coming.

playing.title: Cut trades short, don't auto-race
playing.detail: Her Duelist passive stacks healing the longer she's hitting you, so prolonged auto-for-auto trading favors her sustain — use your E stun to end fights quickly instead of standing and trading.

playing.title: Watch for her Burst of Speed window
playing.detail: Once she pops E (Burst of Speed), every landed attack or Lunge speeds her up further and she'll chase to stick on you — this is when your own E is most valuable to dodge her attacks and cut the chase short.

playing.title: Keep swinging once R is active
playing.detail: R (Relentless Assault) has no cooldown and grants stacking attack speed with bonus damage every third consecutive strike, so once you're committed in melee range from level 6 on, keep attacking through instead of disengaging.

playing.title: Play for the wave pre-6
playing.detail: Before your E cooldown comes down and W is ranked up, you have no answer to her free double-Lunge poke — let the wave push to you near tower rather than extending for trades you can't win.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the trade timing, cooldown reads, and power-spike windows are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Whoever stuns their opponent with either Counter Strike [E] or Riposte (W) will win the fight.
